method: Separate visual inspection of6 selected original backgrounds,6 actualfinal500pxpreviews together,6 expanded390pxmobileeditor views and6 personalizedPDFrasters. Glyph bounds/contrast inreport.json.
paletteReview: Rich emerald/tangerine childbirthday and cobalt/graphite18thbirthday contrast with warmapricotfirstbirthday, refinedivorywedding, palebluebaptism and glacierbluebirthcelebration; no universal background/fontpair/layout.

history.limitation: Supporting comparison, not aesthetic approval; actual motifs/compositions reviewed.

designs.name: Mišji prvi piknik
designs.motif: sa malim mišem i šumskim jagodama
designs.description: Pozivnica za prvi rođendan dečaka sa malim mišem i šumskim jagodama na toploj podlozi. Uredi veliko ime, broj jedan, datum i mesto proslave.
designs.imageAlt: Detaljno ilustrovan mali miš među crvenim šumskim jagodama i zelenim listovima na podlozi boje kajsije
designs.details: Mali miš, šumske jagode i nežan geometrijski dezen oblikuju toplu rođendansku priču. Ilustracija vodi gornji deo, a veliko ime, povezan broj jedan i povod i praktični podaci raspoređeni su ispod. Svi tekstovi se menjaju u editoru, a pozadina ostaje bez ugrađenih slova.
designs.reason: Detailed fur, seeds and leaves share the warm apricot/cocoa palette with a restrained woven texture. Large geometric name/age below the storybook scene are balanced by measured serif supporting lines.
designs.composition: Upper-middle illustration; lower large name/age; splitdate/time; wide location.
designs.trim: Entire mouse, curledtail, berries and principalfoliage safely inside60px targetinset; fine continuous texture bleeds.

designs.name: Kobaltni prelom
designs.motif: sa kobaltnim geometrijskim lukovima i finim metalik linijama
designs.description: Moderna pozivnica za 18. rođendan sa kobaltnim lukovima, tamnom podlogom i finim metalik linijama. Personalizuj ime, veliki broj osamnaest i podatke večeri.
designs.imageAlt: Kobaltni i grafitni zakrivljeni geometrijski oblici sa tankim toplim metalik linijama
designs.details: Kobalt, grafit i tanke metalik linije grade savremenu geometrijsku kompoziciju. Veliko ime i izražen broj osamnaest prate široko tamno polje, dok praktični podaci ostaju čitljivi ispod. Uredi ime, broj godina, poruku, datum, vreme, adresu i potvrdu dolaska.
designs.reason: Cobalt/graphite geometry and fine metallic contours support a contemporary editorial invitation. Oversized Bodoni-derived name/18 and neutralSora details share restrained ivory. All type sits in the clear darkfield, preserving the lower graphic sweep.
designs.composition: Asymmetric left-centred type; broad graphicbands right/below.
designs.trim: Abstract colorfields intentionally bleed; all text has measured60px safety.
repairs: First timefield crossed a brightline. Name/age/details repositioned inupperdarkfield; default/long/mobile/PNG/PDF checks repeated.

designs.name: Lemurova džungla
designs.description: Živopisna pozivnica za dečji rođendan sa lemurom, tropskim listovima i narandžastim cvetom. Primer je za šest godina; ime i uzrast od 3 do 10 se uređuju.
designs.imageAlt: Lemur prstenastog repa na grani među bujnim zelenim listovima i narandžastim cvetom na smaragdnoj podlozi
designs.details: Detaljno ilustrovan lemur i izražajne zelene i narandžaste boje stvaraju veselu džunglu. Ime i uzrast vode gornji levi deo, a datum, vreme i mesto imaju zaseban prostor desno. Primer je za šesti rođendan dečaka; uzrast od tri do deset, ime i sve detalje proslave možeš promeniti.
designs.reason: Precise fur, expressive face and a complete inward-curledtail are integrated with richly painted tropicalfoliage and a tangerine passionflower. Emerald/ivory contrast and a large geometric name/age give a vivid childappropriate result; right eventcolumn uses the clearfield beside the animal.
designs.composition: Upperleft name/age; upperright date/time/place/message; jungleillustration flows below.
designs.trim: Primary lemur, complete tail and orangeflower are safely inset. Secondary continuous foliage/branch intentionally forms a fullbleed ground; not every backgroundleaf is claimed inset.

designs.name: Anemonin potpis
designs.motif: sa belim anemonama i finim grančicama
designs.description: Svečana pozivnica za venčanje sa belim anemonama i velikim imenima mladenaca. Uredi datum, obred, restoran i potvrdu dolaska, pa preuzmi PNG ili PDF.
designs.imageAlt: Dve bele anemone tamnoplavih središta sa zelenim grančicama na toploj svetloj teksturi
designs.details: Bele anemone i fine grančice oblikuju botanički gornji deo. Velika kurzivna serifna imena imaju širok prostor ispod, uz zajednički datum i odvojene podatke venčanja i svadbene proslave. Oba imena, lokacije, vremena i potvrda dolaska uređuju se zasebno.
designs.reason: Fine petalveins, inkblue flowercentres and restrained neutraltexture form a cohesive botanicalsurface. Large italicBodoni-derived names share a clearaxis; serif details and generous spacing carry the ceremonial tone without markerhandwriting.
designs.composition: Horizontal upperbotanical arrangement; large names below; paired ceremony/reception columns.
designs.trim: Both primary anemoneblooms/centres safely inset. Minor peripheralstem/leaf tips are backgrounddetail. All text meets measured60px safety.
designs.fontPair: Napravi Sonata (Bodoni Moda Italic) + Napravi Knjiga (Lora)

designs.name: Plava nit blagoslova
designs.motif: sa plavom brojanicom i srebrnim krstom
designs.description: Elegantna pozivnica za krštenje dečaka sa plavom brojanicom i srebrnim krstom. Promeni veliko ime, datum i odvojene podatke obreda i porodične proslave.
designs.imageAlt: Plava pletena brojanica sa malim srebrnim krstom na svetloplavoj teksturi tkanja
designs.details: Plava brojanica sa srebrnim krstom prati mirnu svetloplavu teksturu. Kratak uvod stoji uz motiv, a veliko klasično ime, naziv događaja i praktični podaci ispod. Vreme i lokacija obreda i proslave imaju zasebna izmenjiva polja.
designs.reason: Carefully rendered wovenknots and small silvercross relate to paleblue linen and deepink type. A restrained intro balances the bracelet, while the large classicalname anchors separate readableceremony/reception columns below.
designs.composition: Upperright prayerrope; upperleft intro; broad centred name/details below.
designs.trim: Complete prayerrope andcross safely inset; continuous linen ground bleeds; all text measured.

designs.name: Polarni mali zagrljaj
designs.description: Poziv na proslavu rođenja dečaka sa polarnom medvedicom i mladunčetom. Dodaj veliko ime bebe, toplu poruku i podatke proslave, pa izvezi PNG ili PDF.
designs.imageAlt: Polarna medvedica i malo mladunče dodiruju se njuškama na nežnoj ledenoplavoj pozadini
designs.details: Nežan susret polarne medvedice i mladunčeta najavljuje novu porodičnu radost. Ilustracija ostaje u gornjem delu, a veliko kurzivno ime i jasan poziv na proslavu rođenja imaju prostor ispod. Ime, poruka, datum, vreme i mesto menjaju se u editoru.
designs.reason: Detailed ivoryfur, a gentle naturalgesture and a softly painted snowground support the familytheme. A large Lora-derived italicname supplies a warm focalpoint; neutral supportingtext preserves clear hierarchy and birthcelebration wording.
designs.composition: Mother/cubscene above; wide italicname below; paireddate/time and centredlocation.
designs.trim: Complete mother/cub figures safely inset; tonal ground may bleed; all text measured.
